full_judgment: Syed Mahmud Hossain J: This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 21.01.2009 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 4555 of 2003 making the rule absolute and reversing those dated 25.09.2003 passed by the District Judge, Comilla in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 07 of 2003 allowing the said appeal and setting aside those dated 14.01.2003 passed by the Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla in Miscellaneous Pre-emption Case No. 7 of 1976 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 dismissing the same on contest.
